description: Universal switchable host for VB lens components; JS API: activeLens (read-only), setLens(name)

attributes.name: data-lens-default
attributes.description: Lens name to show on first load

attributes.name: data-lens-src
attributes.description: Shared JSON source URL forwarded to lens children lacking their own data-lens-src/src (order-independent; already-upgraded children are re-initialised)

events.name: content-lens:change
events.description: Fires when the reader or setLens() changes the active lens; not on the initial/restored selection

childAttributes.name: data-lens-name
childAttributes.description: Registers the child as a switchable lens; value used by data-lens-default, setLens() and the event detail

properties.name: activeLens
properties.description: data-lens-name of the visible lens ('' before upgrade).

methods.name: setLens(name)
methods.description: Switch to the named lens (ignored if unknown). Persists the choice; fires content-lens:change only when the lens actually changes.
